description.en:
Volkswagen Gol G5 (2009-2012) for Farming Simulator 25.
Features: - Detailed 3D exterior and interior with steering wheel animation and character IK targets - 3 EA111 VHT engine options: 1.0 VHT (76 hp), 1.6 VHT (104 hp), and 1.6 VHT Stage 1 ME7.5.30 (125 hp) - 6 factory Volkswagen paint colors (Ninja Black, Crystal White, Sirius Silver, Spectrus Gray, Flash Red, Boreal Blue) - Working headlights, high beams, brake lights, and reverse lights - Rear trailer hitch (trailerCar) and 55 L fuel tank
description.br:
Volkswagen Gol G5 (2009-2012) para Farming Simulator 25.
Recursos: - Modelo 3D detalhado (exterior e interior) com volante animado e alvos IK para o motorista - 3 motorizacoes EA111 VHT: 1.0 VHT (76 cv), 1.6 VHT (104 cv) e 1.6 VHT Stage 1 ME7.5.30 (125 cv) - 6 cores originais Volkswagen (Preto Ninja, Branco Cristal, Prata Sirius, Cinza Spectrus, Vermelho Flash e Azul Boreal) - Farois baixos/altos, luzes de freio e luz de re funcionais - Engate traseiro para reboque (trailerCar) e tanque de 55 L
